marta (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the Q4 hiring signal. wanted to clarify a few items folks asked about in the live chat.
igor (Product): curious about the new 'pilot credits' you mentioned 
are those tied to specific customers or product milestones?
marta (People Ops): good callout. pilot credits are unlocked by two things: 1) closed pilot deals that hit a revenue threshold, 2) internal milestone gates (e.g., Dedicated GA in a region). credits are earmarked for Platform or Customer-facing hires only.
sam (Eng Manager): will pilot credits be available immediately or after invoicing? we've got a candidate who needs an answer.
yvette (Sales): from Sales side: credits vest once a signed pilot converts and the invoice posts (or 30 days after go-live for self-serve pilots). ops will flag unlocked credits in the tracker.
marta (People Ops): mechanics: managers still file the short form. if credits exist for your org, the committee auto-allocates against matching reqs before pulling from the general pool.
igor (Product): any limit on how credits are used? can Platform use a pilot credit to hire a PM instead of an SRE?
marta (People Ops): they should be used for hires directly tied to delivering the pilot or the product commitment. committee approval required for cross-role usage. justification should call out expected pilot outcomes.
sam (Eng Manager): internal transfers 
are we still prioritizing them? several ICs asked about moving into growth/product pods.
marta (People Ops): yes, internal transfers are a priority. if a transfer creates a backfill need we'll try to fill it from that org's credit allotment first. if none exist, it goes to the normal committee queue.
yvette (Sales): will Sales credits ever convert to general headcount? some pilots may not convert but still need onboarding support.
marta (People Ops): if a pilot fails to convert but the work is still valuable, managers can file a business-case to keep the credit; committee reviews on a case-by-case basis.
noah (CEO): context: this approach lets us expand where revenue or product milestones justify it, but keeps overall discipline. managers: be explicit about deliverables tied to hires.
tracker-bot: [automated] hiring tracker updated: https://redwood/tracker | pilot-credits column populated where applicable.
igor (Product): thanks 
can you post the tracker link and a 1-pager about pilot credit rules? i'll share with PMs.
marta (People Ops): will do 
i'll post links and a small FAQ in #all-hands in 30m. DM me for urgent offer cases. :white_check_mark:
